name: texttools2
description: The second batch of 2.11BSD text tools runs from a staged script, so the needles are outputs and never the typed command: sort orders three words and sorts numbers with -n; find names the one file both -name and -type match; xargs appends its input to echo's arguments; diff's normal output for a one-line change; diff -h goes through /usr/libexec/diffh, whose range for a change at end of file is `3,$'; diff3's first line names the file that differs; patch applies diff's output to a copy; pr's header carries -h's title and the page number.  find's needle went red with its predicates still reading struct anode through the PDP-11 overlay.
